chronology: Registered after actual AA/C four-view failure and before this qualification or D render; not an initial preregistration
evidence_trigger: C vs latest baseline fails primary near seam, a6, original-road and nonroad preservation; C-vs-AA geometry is exact, so colour fitting alone cannot remove the added support effects
information_role: These four views are now BUILD calibration and diagnostic validation, not independent HELD evaluation
source_asset: Exact original C40392 child rows with original geometry, relativeMip, opacity and colour
measurement: Two differentiable constant-one auxiliary row features measure unnormalised native visible contribution mass inside road and inside frozen guard; no Gaussian or RGB variable requires grad
road_domain: Original obs.road; DELETE additionally original obs.road_edit intersect original fixed ground_beneath_a37_proxy
guard: Frozen nonroad geometry guard union original a5/a6 visible masks; KEEP additionally original a37 visible mask
selection: Initial safe child rows = summed_inside_mass>0 AND summed_guard_mass==0, using exact zero, no threshold/colour/metric search
runtime: One immutable checkpoint/asset/row-order-bound 3D child-row sidecar intersects only additional road.mask; same selected rows for every query and edit state
prohibited: query GT or query mask row selection
occlusion_caveat: Removing rows can expose retained rows. A zero mass measured under the full added layer is not alone a proof of preservation after filtering. Actual D replay and frozen gates are mandatory; any refinement must preserve a monotone shrinking row set and be separately logged.
empty_result: Do not render or invent a relaxed threshold to rescue an empty safe set
same_scene_scope: Only measured calibration views until further verification; no unseen-camera or future-topology guarantee
